nom: RoC Vitamin C Brightening Face Serum for Dull Skin & Uneven Skin Tone

avis.texte: As someone with seasonsl ezcema that usually flares in the winter, this has caused me to have ezcema patches on my eyelids, under my eye, and the corners of my mouth after a few months of usage. I didn't have that issue with thr first bottle, but the second bottle did my skin in. After I stopped using it, my patches began to fade. I would not recommend this product to anyone with sensitive or acne prone skin.
Brightened my skin, faded acne scars, and noticed a more even skin tone! It is also a great primer for makeup (with sunscreen layered on top)!

I love this serum. I has a light scent, but it is not overpowering, and you do not smell it throughout the day. It is easy to apply, and it lasts a nice amount of time with daily use. It is mildly more gel like than a creamy serum, but it is not sticky on the face. I'm a repeat buyer of this serum.

A bit sticky when you out it on and makes my face feel a bit tight but once it's absorbed and I put my moisturizer on, ever works out fine. It's great for mature skin and the price is much cheaper than other serums I've tried.
This is the best Vitamin C cream I've found! I tried the Elf and off brand and they do not compare to this one! I will always purchase this one!
Looooveeeee this vitamin C!! Since it's a blend versus just vitamin C it makes it more affordable, but I promise it works just as well! Makes my skin look so vibrant!
This serum glides on, and isn't greasy. I have noticed that my dark spots have substantially lightened.
Tried it 2 days. It makes your make-up peel. Wanted to love it but i could not wear it in the daytime so its a no for me.
This product literally deleted my dark marks in one month. It leaves my skin looking like glass. I just love this product so much.
I use this product after cleansing my face in the morning. It's quickly absorbed, and as soon as it dries, I follow with ROC Hydration + Moisturizer with Sunscreen. My skin looks and feels amazing!

avis.titre: Great if wearing by itself- pills with other products
avis.texte: I use retinol at night, so I use my vitamin C during the day. I do vitamin C as a base layer, then moisturizer, sunscreen, and a very light amount of makeup. This is the only vitamin C serum I have had pill so badly with other products on top. If you use it by itself it is excellent, but that is not a realistic use for me. Unfortunately, I won't repurchase.

I like this product, but notice it says Roc 2019" on the back just today. Serums have a max shelf like of 3 years so it would have expired over three years ago! Not cool, Ulta. Try this product from somewhere else or check the date first.
My skin has never been so glowy and healthy since I started using this serum. It's perfect for daily use and has even improved my skin tone! This is my second bottle!
Never received the item. Waited and waited but never received it. The tracking never moved. So I can't say how good it is because I never got to use it.
I love using my serum daily and it makes my skin feel hydrated and gives it it a glow!
Non irritating moisturizer. Long lasting brightness on my cheeks.
Love the way this works on my skin. Even my dermatologist noticed an improvement
It's wonmderful. My skin was noticably improved in just a couple of days.

I bought this 5 days ago and am definitely seeing results. It is unbelievable. My skin is softer, brighter and more even toned. I have very sensitive skin, so I took a chance when I bought this serum. I've used Perricone MD products for years, but ROC will now be my go to line,
This daily serum is a must if you wish to brighten that complexion all day! Absorbs quickly with no greasy feel.

I started getting little bumps all over my face and neck and didn't know why. I heard that some vitamin C serums can break you out, so I stopped using it and the bumps went away. not sure if this did anything good for my skin since I had to stop using it so quickly. maybe this would work for someone less acne prone but idk

avis.titre: This would be my HG but theres one thing..
avis.texte: I saw the positive reviews this vit c serum had and thought how could i not try this,and one thing about RoC is that they are very reliable and tried and true. The results I've had with this serum I have never seen in any other skin care products except with dermalogica products. This will truly truly transform your skin; I saw true results in 4 -6 weeks so please don't think its not working just give it time!! My only thing is that unfortunately it has Yellow 6 and I do not want that in my skincare. Until they decide to remove that ingredient from the product I will use something else. Otherwise a Fantastic product.
I've been using this for 2 weeks and can tell the difference in my skins texture and complexion. Definitely evens skin tone. I even see a difference in my pores.
Feel good and smells amazing. Use in the morning and I love the barrier it seems to give me.
I love Roc but this particular serum has not revived or made my skin glow. I feel like all my fine lines are out to show.

I have not used this vitamin C brightening serum long enough yet to say that it does diminish dark spots and even out skin tone. But I do like how it feels going on my skin and how it quickly absorbs. Fragrance is light. I am hoping to see good results over time. I trust the brand.
It's thick and sticky. It smells good but I had to wash it off.
This is awesome it really works very well after a couple uses
I love this serum! It smoothes my skin and has evened out my skin tone. I won't go without it!
I found this serum is very sticky, shiny and drying to the face. Making the fine fines more pronounced.
This serum feels luxurious on my skin and I watch it instantly brighten my face.

I love this product, have used it for years! Smells wonderful, goes on light and makes me feel like I don't even need to follow it up with moisturizer. I do though because I love the ROC Vitamin C day cream.
This product was returned. I had breakouts. It left my dace greasy. .
This serum has been a great addition to my daily routine, finishing a bottle and being excited to purchase a replacement always feels like a good indicator that I've found a good product!

I love how this serum makes my skin look and feel. instantly brightens and has improved the texture of my skin. It is softer, smoother, and brighter. I don't know that it fades dark spots but it definitely helps even out tone. I use it day and night and my daughter also loves it. Non-sticky and unscented. It has been an essential part of my skin care routine for the past 3 years.
Why is there yellow 6 in this? I dont want to ingest yellow 6, nor do I want to put it on my face.

I have normal/combo oily skin. Mid-30s and acne-prone so I need to be careful with new products. I've had to get rid of products after two uses due to reactions. But NOT THIS ONE! I had a lot of acne scaring on my cheeks from hormone fluctuations in the last few years. After one bottle of this Vit C, those dark spots have drastically decreased. My skin looks nearly smooth and consistent again. This plus my other skin care products helped my face in general clear up. Tbh i got this first bottle free in an Ulta gift but I think it may be a permanent addition to my skincare routine.
Horrible sticky feel, and to top it off it made me break out!
I love this product. My skin looks amazingly bright after using this product!

avis.titre: Extremely bad reaction with this serum
avis.texte: BEWARE OF THIS SERUM, I used it once and immediately my skin started to turn red and then next morning my face and eyes were swollen , eyes were swollen so bad that they almost shut it has been 4 days and my skin is still red and itches..not only my face but the itching also is on my scalp and otger places in my body ...this is a dange6product I would give it a 0..if I could..I never write any reviews but felt compelled to tell what happened to me...please do not buy this of you are sensitive...
This product is good if you want a serum that is not sticky and gentle. Its not a bad product however theres better vitamin C products for the price.
My skin glows everyday that I wear this Multi Correxion. Love it!

This stuff is crazy. It moisturizes, doesn't make my skin greasy, AND makes my face look like I have a tan. I can't even get my face to look tan when the rest of my body is. Now I can use sunblock and be tan. Also, I'm 36 and have a lot of skin damage from tanning. I'm using a combo of like 4 Roc products and my skin looks a lot younger than it did.
I am 47. This product made my skin dry. & no difference in my skin.
Love the feel, see small improvements but can't wait to compare at end of month. Been using as instructed every morning and night
My skin has an extra glow to it! My dark circles have decreased
I like the product , but this is the 2nd time i bought it & the topper yet again produced a hole in the top which causes the suction not to work.

avis.titre: Roc Revive & Glow is the BEST!
avis.texte: LUV this product! My senior skin has a smoother texture and actually glows. It's a permanent step in my at home skin care.
I've only used this product for a week and I can see the difference from before

avis.titre: I buy this product over and over
avis.texte: Love this product. Seems to brighten my complexion since I wear little makeup.

avis.titre: Best Choice Especially Considering the Price
avis.texte: Works great for all the things Vitamin C does for your skin. It's priced more than fair compared some of the more expensive products. Typically Vitamin C at this price point just sits on the skin whereas RoC absorbs in and instantly brightens.

avis.titre: LOVE THIS Vitamin C Serum, all I use!!
avis.texte: This is the second time I have purchased this and Absolutely Love how it actually does brighten my skin and removes dark areas. I have used other products twice as pricey and never got results like I do with this. Great for sensitive skin too!
These products are very good. I'm totally happy with everything I use. I believe Roc products do what they claim, and for a reasonable price. It's my go to for all my facial needs. Thanks!

avis.titre: Not good if your skin is sensitive
avis.texte: I've never thought that I had sensitive skin! By the 3rd application, I had red, swollen, burning bags under eye area (I didn't even place product near eyes!). I also had a breakout on cheek. Might work for some, but unfortunately not me. Had to return.

avis.titre: Best Vitamin C serum I've tried
avis.texte: Out of all the different brands I've tried, this is the best Vitamin C serum. This is now my go-to.

broke me out terrible. stopped/starting using it to be sure it was this product- it was. Ive used different c serums in the past with no issue, something specifically in this clogs pores. absolutely stinks because it did make my skin GLOW so beautifully! returning.

I received my order and it was open and the box looked so old. On the box it shows that it was supposed to have a cream that comes with, but it was removed and replaced with small packets of cream instead which I didn't like. :(

My regular company discontinued my 20% Vitamin C. NOTHING has come close! This form of C is decent. Sucks it's 10% and not 20%. It's a decent substitute of what I need until I find 20% or higher. I respond very well to Vit C and I saw the brightness.

avis.titre: Highly recommended for all skin types
avis.texte: Enriched Vitamin C serum works quickly and effectively to lighten dark spots. Gives your skin a great feeling that is smooth and supple. Works wonders for a new and brightened appearance and glow. This unique formula evens out all skin types and tones

I was so excited to try this but it made me break out after my first time using it. I know Vitamin C's have a purging period but it made my skin so irritated i had to stop using after my second use. Probably going to return it. I have normal to dry skin.

This serum is soooo goood! I have acne prone and sensitive skin so trying to find the right vitamin c serum that doesn't break me out is so difficult. But this serum takes the cake ive seen a huge difference all of my dark spots are fading and its not breaking me out 10/10!!!!

The product is not sticky and feels good on the skin. I had some kind of allergic reaction. I didn't want to believe it was this product but same thing happened when I tried it a second time. Use caution.

I like the scent and feel of the serum on my skin. It's too soon to evaluate its effectiveness. I've only been using the product for 3 weeks. My rule of thumb is to give any product 6 to 8 weeks of daily use.
I've been using it for about 6 weeks now and although it feels great going on, it is causing me to breakout. It's too bad; I was hopeful.

I was having severe hormonal acne & my curolgist put me on trinotin. Everyone knows that makes your skin dry. This serum helped my acne go down so much along with helping my skin not be so dry from the medication.

I will start by saying that the product smells great. As far as quality I'm not sure it does much for brightness. I have hurt myself twice by slicing my index finger when trying to twist off the cap. Super sharp if you aren't paying attention.
The serum works well. It is smooth and lightweight, but plan to allow your skin time to adapt to the serum.

I bought this after looking at the reviews & finally adding a vitamin c serum to my daily morning face routine, but i think my face looked better before adding this .. im gonna try another brand to see if it was this one in particular. But i probably wouldn't buy this again.

I have been using this for about three weeks and I can tell a difference. I feel like my skin looks brighter and more even I got this as a set and this is by far my favorite product out of it. I will definitely keep using it. I even went to the dermatologist this week and she said whatever you're doing keep doing it so it must be making a big difference.

avis.titre: Feel good serum with vitamin C!
avis.texte: I've been using it every morning and evening while doing my routine and I feel so far that my skin has a nice even color tone. So far so good.

I initially thought wow! love the glow it gives my skin. Unfortunately within a week my joy turned to tears as my skin turned dry, ashy, tremendously flaky and irritated. I'm having to restart in search of a complete line from cleansers, serums to moisturizer in effort to repair the damage.
This product smells and feels good but my bottle is almost gone after using daily, and there are no visible results.

avis.titre: Help with acne scarring and sun damage
avis.texte: Im about to purchase this bottle for the third time. Its so good! My skin is acne prone so anything will break me out, but this doesnt! It helps with my acne scars and any sunburn. When i pair this with my moisturizer, my skin looks SO good.

I was on the hunt for a new vitamin c serum since the truth serum from ole henriksen increased in price.. Im extremely picky about vitC serums (the texture and smell have to be on point for me) but this one is perfect! It smells of a natural orange juice scent and absorbs quickly. It is slightly tacky, which I personally dont mind because it goes away and can be great as a primer before makeup. So happy I found this!
At first. I was skeptical. But, now, this RoC skincare product has made me speechless.

I have been using this serum for months now and have repurchased. It helps my skin look glowy and takes away texture. My skins feels and looks healthier! I love the light orange scent and it is easy to apply. After application it does feel slightly sticky, but moisturizer after the serum dries removes any tackiness. Has not irritated my skin or caused any breakouts. A great product!

My husband and I decided to give this product a try, and we've been amazed by the daily improvement in our skin's appearance. It's not limited to women; it's effective for men as well. We highly recommend this product into your daily routine!
This serum really smooths out my skin and gives it a nice glow
I am in love with this serum. It makes my face glow and look healthier. My skin feels so much softer and smooth. My dark spots have faded drastically and I highly recommend this.
Just starting using less than two weeks and a noticeable brightness has occurred!! Love this stuff. Very gentle as well. Will continue to buy this stuff!
it gives me the glow i want also evens out my skin.. result is visible when i less expect.
Will Forever use this vitamin c . This is will always been in my skin care routine

avis.titre: I will never get this product again.
avis.texte: I've tried lots of serums and this is one is terrible. My skin has no shine, nice texture, it's like I'm putting nothing on. I will never get this product again.

avis.titre: Hard to tell for me and pricey
avis.texte: So i can see it has help in a way. My skin looks revived so i look a lil more alive but i cannot say it has help correct my uneven skin tone. I have tanish/yellow tone and mainly darker spots on my cheeks.

I love this vitamin c serum! I have noticed a significant difference in my hyperpigmentation and my skin looks brighter and even. I also love the thick consistency, it feels so hydrating but sinks into your skin nicely.

avis.titre: Really like the glow it gives But not for acne prone skin.
avis.texte: It gave me a beautiful glow but didnt work out for me it broke me out the night i used it and everytime i applied i got a new breakout. So sad but had to return

I have combination skin with a lot of inflammation, mild acne, and both light and dark scarring. My skin isn't sensitive but I usually don't notice much difference when I use different products. I was SO SHOCKED at how this made my skin look and feel. It is definitely sticky and has a strong orange scent but the scent fades and I just wait for it to absorb into my skin before I continue on in my skincare routine. Adding moisturizer on top of it immediately takes away the stickiness. My skin was GLOWING all day after using this. It looks more even-toned and less inflammed throughout the day. I've used it for a few days and each day it looks like this . HIGHLY RECOMMEND.
The Serum soaks in quickly. Doesn't seem to sit on top my face.

I've been looking for a good vitamin c serum, since most of the ones I've tried dry my face out too much. This one is perfect. I use it with the Retinol Correxion hydrating cream and a sunscreen every morning and my skin is noticeably more bright/clear. It also smells great, like oranges.
goes a long way.. I use another brand which already made my skin look better, however this seems to be working just as well so I plan to switch from my current super expensive serum to this.

This product was recommended by my dermatologist. I am surprisingly pleased. At 66-years old, I do not expect a return to the great skin of my youth; I am interested in the overall health of my skin. This product is really good, IMO. It feels nourishing and does not require a great amount to cover my entire face & neck. It is surprising viscous for a serum - not sticky. I am very pleased.
Brightening and gives you a subtle glow for the morning. Makes me feel awake!

I've started skin cycling and so I needed to find a Vit C serum. It has a nice orangey scent upon application, but I do get a bit of a sticky feeling when applying. I think that's okay though because when I put on my combo moisturizer and sunscreen I definitely look and feel dewy and glowy. Whereas before with just my moisturizer I'd look a bit dull. I'm younger so I'm not concerned about fine lines but I'm hopeful it can help out my acne scarring.

This product is an easy use and it's pretty light as long as you use a little because a little goes a very long way. But so far it has been working very well and I have only be using for about 4 days and can see slight differences. I def recommend this product for dark areas/spots from acne or dark spots in general.
I'm 59 and used the serum twice a day for two weeks. My skin tone is much brighter, firmer, and even as well as looking more dewy.

avis.titre: Love this gel like serum and feels lovely on
avis.texte: Feels cooling on skin and gives nice glow to the cheeks and forehead areas
I absolutely love this serum ❤️❤️ Everyone should add this to there routine ..
Can see difference immediately, my skin looks brighter and younger

I use this ROC serum on my face at night and on my neck morning and night. I'm 61 and have normal skin but lots of sun damage from years on the beach. I've tried numerous products including some far more expensive brands but this serum beats them all! It has noticeably faded my brown spots and my skin feels firm, hydrated and healthy. I don't use in the morning because I use a serum primer for my makeup but even once a day has made a difference. I'm just finishing my first bottle which has lasted me about two months. Worth the money! I am purchasing again and definitely recommend.
Finally, a vitamin C serum that doesn't pill with SPF! Absolutely love this stuff. Feels great going on and I've only used half the bottle after 2 months of using it every day!

I love the way this serum feels on my face! Applies easily, no odor and it definitely gives my face a glow. I already used one full bottle and ready to purchase again. This is one of my top 5 skin care routine products.
I noticed in a few days that my face/skin has a glow and some dark spots have lightened.
It's immediately effective in making the skin feel smooth and hydrated

Worst! It dried out my skin severely. It caused redness so bad it started scaling. I couldn't figure out what was happening until I stopped using. I had changed my diet etc. trying to figure out what it was. The only other thing I could think of that was new to my routine was this brand of vit C serum. Once I stopped using, my skin cleared up and it was back to normal. I sent used in about 1 month so I thought, hmm… let me give it another chance. Nope! Later In The day my skin started again and the redness and itching started up again. Maybe it's not just for me but it was the worst!
I love this product. I was dealing with super dry skin on my face and this serum has been a game changer. I use it daily and receive compliments on my fresh face look!
I really like the feel of this serum on my skin. I put it on after washing my face and then put the daily moisturizer over it. My face feels good all day long.

avis.titre: It does exactly what it says but no perfume maybe ?
avis.texte: I love almost everything about this product only the perfume smell so strong would be better if I can have more choice with no fragrance My dark spot fade away my skin getting smoother and my Fine lines look so much better !
After just a few days I can tell my tone is evening out and my face is so soft!
I love this product. The serum is light and doesn't feel greasy. I am actually seeing a difference after just a few weeks.

Tried for month, in the beginning it felt great. I noticed it was a bit drying to my skin. I used it every other morning followed by moisturizer and spf. It felt thick. It does have fragrance. Maybe not for me.
I love the way this serum feels going on my skin and then it sinks right in and isn't sticky!
Really makes a difference. I am almost 74 and my sister who is 8 years younger said my skin looked great

avis.titre: Finally a product that actually works!
avis.texte: Love this product! People don't believe that I'm 63. Been using Roc for for years. Not a wrinkle on my face.
